outfitLogs.notes: Tailored charcoal coat over ivory merino and wide wool trousers—effortless.
Olive chore jacket + grey tee + dark selvedge denim is a reliable weekend uniform.
Cropped leather moto jacket balanced the wide pleated trousers nicely.
Burgundy acrylic sweater felt scratchy and overheated under the wool coat.
Indoor try-on for spring smart-casual proportions.
